blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recovering the continuous world-space motion of both hands from egocentric video is essential for applications such as human-to-robot policy transfer and augmented reality. Achieving this goes beyond reconstructing the hands from each individual frame, as the context that a frame needs is often spread over time, especially around occlusions or when a hand moves out of sight. Recent works have explored how to exploit temporal context, yet they mostly draw it from fixed-length windows. Such windows cannot guarantee that every frame has the context required to reconstruct the hands in world space with accurate poses and metric scale. To address this limitation, we introduce MemHand, a memory-enhanced framework for world-space hand motion reconstruction. MemHand maintains two complementary forms of memory. The Short-Term Event Memory keeps the context of the well-observed hand around each occlusion or out-of-sight event and supplies it to frames with weak or missing visual evidence. In addition, since the metric scale holds over the whole recording, the Long-Term Scale Memory retains the most reliable observations across the video as scale anchors within a bounded state. Across benchmarks featuring severe occlusions and frequent out-of-sight intervals, MemHand achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and generalizes well to unseen domains. Benefiting from the synergy of both memories, it cuts W-MPJPE by 57\% on ARCTIC and 70\% on HOT3D relative to StableHand, delivering continuous and metrically accurate world-space hand poses and trajectories. We will release our code and models at the project page: https://irmvlab.github.io/memhand.github.io
blocks.zh: 从以自我为中心的视频中恢复双手不断的世界-空间运动,对于诸如人对机器人政策转移和增强现实等应用至关重要。 实现这一点超越了从每个单个框架重建出手,因为一个框架需要的背景往往随时间而分散,特别是在被隔离或一只手离开视线时. 近期的作品探索了如何利用时间背景,但它们大多取自固定长的窗口. 这种窗口不能保证每个框架都具有以准确的姿势和尺度重建世界空间中的双手所需的背景。 为了解决这一限制,我们引入了MemHand,这是世界空间手动运动重建的记忆强化框架. MemHand保持两种互补的记忆形式. "短期事件记忆"保留了每个隐蔽或外视事件周围的可观察手的上下文,并用弱或缺失的视觉证据提供框架. 此外,由于衡量尺度覆盖整个记录,长期尺度内存保留了整个视频中最可靠的观测数据,作为标定状态下的尺度主播. 在所有以严重隔离和频繁外出间隔为特点的基准中,MemHand实现了最先进的准确性,并很好地概括到看不见的领域。 从这两个记忆的协同效应中获益,在ARCTIC上削减了W-MPJPE57分,在HOT3D上削减了相对于StableHand的70分,传递出连续而直线准确的世界空间手姿和轨迹. 我们将在项目网页上公布我们的代码和模型:https://irmvlab.github.io/memand.github.io。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Egocentric video is emerging as a scalable way to collect demonstrations for robot learning [ 18 , 5 , 6 ] . The hands in these videos carry valuable motion knowledge and interaction patterns with the surroundings [ 8 , 19 , 12 , 11 ] , making hand reconstruction an important interface between human videos and robot policies [ 30 , 26 , 38 , 17 ] . While single-frame hand reconstruction has advanced considerably in recent years, the target for a policy is typically the metric world-space motion of both hands over the video rather than per-frame estimates. Accordingly, world-space hand motion reconstruction has received growing attention [ 43 , 41 , 42 ] .
blocks.zh: 爱高中心视频正在成为收集机器人学习演示[18,5,6]的可扩展方式. 这些视频中的手携带了宝贵的运动知识和与周围的相互作用模式[8,19,12,11],使手重建成为了人类视频与机器人政策的重要界面[30,26,38,17]. 虽然近年来单帧手的重建已大有进展,但政策的目标通常是两手在视频上进行的世界空间运动,而不是每帧估计。 因此,世界空间手动运动重建日益受到关注[43、41、42]。

blocks.en: Relative to single-frame hand reconstruction, an important problem in world-space motion estimation is temporal consistency. Across a video, the hand motion has to remain continuous even through challenging scenarios such as occlusions and out-of-sight intervals. To this end, existing video-based methods mostly introduce temporal context from a fixed-length window, using multi-view observations and motion cues over time to supplement the understanding of the hand’s state on frames with limited visual evidence [ 43 , 36 , 13 , 21 , 42 , 28 ] .
blocks.zh: 相对于单帧手重建,世界-空间运动估计的一个重要问题是时间上的一致性. 在一段视频中,手动必须保持连续性,即使是通过隐蔽和视线外间隔等具有挑战性的情景. 为此,现有的基于视频的方法大多从固定长度的窗口引入了时间背景,随着时间的推移,利用多视图观测和运动提示,用有限的视觉证据补充对帧上手的状态的理解[43、36、13、21、42、28]。

blocks.en:
However, these methods implicitly assume that such a fixed window always captures sufficient temporal context. In practice, the context for any one hand is spread unevenly, and where it lies depends on the hand’s state. For example, the position of an out-of-sight hand benefits from where it leaves and where it returns, and an occluded hand is best reconstructed from the context before and after the occlusion. Moreover, the metric scale of the trajectory is pinned down by a few moments that may occur anywhere in the video.
Therefore, constrained by a predefined window size, they cannot reliably capture the temporal context that an accurate estimate at each frame actually requires, limiting further improvements in hand motion reconstruction accuracy.
blocks.zh:
然而,这些方法隐含地假定,这种固定窗口总是能抓住足够的时间背景。 实际上,任何一只手的背景分布不均,其位置取决于手的状态。 例如:外相手的位置从所出地和所回地得到好处,而被取入的手最好从被取入地之前和之后的上下文来重建. 此外,轨迹的尺度还受到录像中任何地方可能发生的几起事件的影响。
因此,由于受到预先定义的窗口大小的限制,它们无法可靠地捕捉每个帧的准确估计实际需要的时间上下文,限制了手动重建精度的进一步改善.

blocks.en:
To address this issue, we instead treat the effective use of temporal context as a memory problem. Because different kinds of context in world-space hand reconstruction have different lifetimes, we replace the fixed window with two complementary forms of memory.
Our Short-Term Event Memory segments the video into flexible-length events such as occlusions or out-of-sight gaps, each spanning from when the hand disappears to when it reappears, and thus encompassing well-observed hands at both ends. Because the temporal relevance of hand motion decays quickly after an event ends, the short-term memory stores dense visual evidence only for the current event duration, enabling whole-event decoding once the event closes. This ensures that a frame with less visual evidence can draw on the context within its event. The context for recording-level constants such as the metric scale matters indefinitely but arrives sparsely and with uneven reliability. Our Long-Term Scale Memory collects candidate observations, from both metric depth estimates and parallax formed by a static hand and a moving head, and retains the most precise ones for scale estimation. Through the complementary combination of the two memories, we achieve accurate world-space hand motion reconstruction. Our contributions are fourfold:

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: Hand reconstruction in camera space. Most monocular methods regress the parameters of the MANO hand model [ 29 ] from a cropped image. HaMeR [ 24 ] showed the effectiveness of scaling a ViT regressor, and WiLoR [ 25 ] couples reconstruction with detection. To leverage temporal context, Deformer [ 4 ] and OmniHands [ 10 ] fuse features within fixed-length windows of sampled frames. Recent approaches take this context from foundation models. ViDiHand [ 36 ] and ACE-Ego-Hand [ 13 ] decode hands from Wan [ 33 ] , and RLHND [ 21 ] from Cosmos 3 [ 23 ] , but context beyond the fixed window is still hard to obtain [ 13 ] . In this work, we move beyond fixed windows, allowing each frame’s context to follow the event it belongs to.
blocks.zh: 手重建在相机空间。 多数单相机方法从被收割的图像中递回了MANO手型 [29] 的参数. HaMER [24] 显示了一个ViT递减器的缩放效果,而WiLOR [25]夫妇通过检测重建. 为了利用时间背景,Defors [4] 和OmniHands [10] 引信在被取样的框架的固定长窗口中的特性。 最近的办法从基础模式中借鉴了这一点。 ViDiHand [36]和ACE-Ego-Hand [13]解码手从Wan [33],和RLHND [21] 从Cosmos 3 [23],但固定窗口以外的上下文仍然很难获得 [13]. 在这个作品中,我们超越了固定的窗口,让每个帧的背景跟随它所属的事件.

blocks.en: Hand reconstruction in world space. Reconstruction in world space additionally estimates the motion of the camera and recovers the metric scale. Dyn-HaMR [ 41 ] optimizes camera pose and hand motion jointly. HaWoR [ 43 ] estimates the camera pose by egocentric SLAM scaled with Metric3D [ 7 ] . StableHand [ 42 ] takes the camera from a geometry foundation model. However, these methods refine per-frame hand estimates [ 24 , 25 ] , so occluded or out-of-sight hands often begin from a weak or missing prior. InfiniHand [ 28 ] instead streams over sliding windows and carries LingBot-Map’s memory [ 2 ] , but this memory serves the camera rather than the hands, hands out of sight are not completed, and the scale relies on post-processing. In this work, we read the metric scale from our long-term memory of the most precise observations, and complete a hand out of sight to produce the continuous hand motion.
blocks.zh: 世界空间的手重建. 世界空间的重建进一步估计了相机的运动并恢复了测量尺度。 Dyn-HAMR [41] 优化相机姿势和手动联合. HaWOR [43] 估计以自负为中心 SLAM 的相机布置 与 Metric3D 缩放 [7]. StableHand [42] 从几何地基模型取相机. 然而,这些方法细化了每个帧的手估计[24,25],因此被困入或失明的手往往从一个弱小或缺失的前作开始. InfiniHand [28] 取而代之的是流过滑动窗口并搭载了LingBot-Map的内存[2],但这种内存服务于相机而非手相机,出视的手没有完成,而天平依赖于后处理. 在这部作品中,我们从对最精确的观察的长期记忆中读取了度量尺度,并完成了一手出视来产生连续的手动.

blocks.en: Memory mechanisms for temporal context. Exploiting temporal context spread across a video has been actively studied in video generation and streaming 3D reconstruction. WorldMem [ 37 ] and Context-as-Memory [ 40 ] keep past frames and retrieve them by camera pose or field-of-view overlap. StreamVGGT [ 46 ] keeps the cached tokens of past frames as implicit memory, and LingBot-Map [ 2 ] divides its memory into anchor frames, a reference window, and a compressed trajectory. Hand reconstruction depends on such context just as much, but in a different form from the visual or geometric consistency these methods seek. The relevant context is largely determined by the hand state itself. In this work, we organize short-term and long-term memories around this property of hand reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 时间背景的记忆机制. 在视频生成和流出3D重建中积极研究了跨越视频的探索时间背景. WorldMem [37] 和 Contex-as-Memory [40] 保持过去帧并用相机姿势或视野重叠取回. StreamVGGT [46] 保留了过去帧的缓存符号作为隐含内存,而LingBot-Map [2] 将其内存分为锚帧,参考窗口,压缩出轨. 手部重建同样取决于这种上下文,但与这些方法所寻求的视觉或几何一致性不同。 相关背景主要由手态本身决定. 在这项工作中,我们围绕这一手重建财产组织短期和长期记忆.

blocks.en: III Method
blocks.zh: 页:1 方法

blocks.en: Given an egocentric video { I t } t = 1 T \{I_{t}\}_{t=1}^{T} , MemHand reconstructs both hands of the camera wearer as MANO [ 29 ] meshes in metric world space, as illustrated in Fig. 2 . MemHand organizes temporal context at three ranges. Within fixed windows, the Hand Localizer decides which hands appear in each frame and tracks their keypoints from the features of a frozen V-JEPA 2.1 encoder [ 22 ] . Beyond a single window, since an occlusion or out-of-sight gap may last longer, the Short-Term Event Memory retains context matching each such event’s variable length to support the reconstruction of both occluded and out-of-sight hands. Spanning the whole recording, the Long-Term Scale Memory keeps the most precise observations of the metric scale within a bounded state. Connecting these three ranges, MemHand localizes in-image hands over fixed windows, reconstructs them in the camera frame with the short-term memory, and lifts them into metric world space along the camera trajectory scaled by the long-term memory. In this world space, each out-of-sight gap is completed from its event context, yielding continuous hand motion.

MemHand在三个范围内组织时间背景. 在固定窗口内,Hand Llocalizer决定每个帧中出现哪个手并从被冻结的V-JEPA 2.1编码器的特性来跟踪其键入点[22]. 在单一窗口之外,由于闭塞或闭塞可能持续更长的时间,短期事件记忆保留了匹配每个事件可变长度的上下文,以支持闭塞和闭塞手的重建。 扩展整个记录,"长期缩放"(Long-Scale Memory)将度量衡最精确的观测值保存在一个有界限的状态下. 将这三个范围连接起来,MemHand将图像中的手放在固定窗口上,在相机框中用短期内存重建这些窗口,并沿着由长期内存所缩放的相机轨迹将其抬入平面世界空间. 在这个世界空间中,每个视差从它的事件背景完成,产生连续的手动.

blocks.en: III-A Hand Localizer
blocks.zh: 手动本地化器

blocks.en: Given the tokens 𝐟 \mathbf{f} of a fixed window from the frozen V-JEPA encoder, the Hand Localizer first decides whether each hand h ∈ { L , R } h\in\{\mathrm{L},\mathrm{R}\} appears in each frame t t , denoted e t h e^{h}_{t} . Whenever a hand is present, it then predicts for each keypoint k k an in-image indicator v t h , k v^{h,k}_{t} , a 2D position 𝐱 t h , k \mathbf{x}^{h,k}_{t} , and an observation confidence m t h , k m^{h,k}_{t} , as shown in Fig. 2 (a). Together, these outputs serve two purposes: (i) detecting and localizing in-image hands, a relatively simple task for which a fixed window suffices [ 13 ] , and (ii) identifying frames where visual evidence is degraded or missing, thus signaling when temporal context from our memory modules must be invoked to complement the fixed window.

blocks.en: Hand existence. We formulate hand existence as identifying the states of the camera wearer’s two hands, rather than localizing every hand as in [ 25 ] . Following slot attention [ 15 ] , three slot queries representing the left hand, right hand, and background first attend to per-frame clip tokens 𝐟 t \mathbf{f}_{t} via soft assignment, preventing both hand slots from claiming the same hand. blocks.en: III-B Short-Term Event Memory
blocks.zh: 三-B 短期事件记忆

blocks.en: While the Hand Localizer’s fixed window is mostly adequate for in-image hand localization, it does not always suffice for hand reconstruction, especially when a hand is occluded or moves out of sight. During such intervals, the contextual information needed to resolve the hand may lie beyond the window, as motion trends and interaction cues unfold over longer temporal spans. The Short-Term Event Memory therefore provides the second range of context, flexibly extending across fixed-window boundaries to capture each complete event, as shown in Fig. 2 (b).
blocks.zh: 虽然Hand Llocalizer的固定窗口大多足以使内相手本地化,但它并不总是足以进行手部重建,特别是当一只手被困住或移动出视线时. 在间隔期间,解决问题所需的背景信息可能位于窗口之外,因为运动趋势和互动提示在较长的时间内展开。 因此,短期事件记忆提供了第二个背景范围,可以灵活地跨越固定窗口边界,捕捉每个完整的事件,如图2(b)所示.

blocks.en:
Event definition. We define two kinds of events, occluded and out of sight. In either kind, an event is an interval together with a leading context and a trailing context. For an occlusion, the interval 𝒪 h = [ a , b ) \mathcal{O}^{h}=[a,b) spans the frames where the mean of m t h , k m^{h,k}_{t} over a hand’s in-image keypoints stays below a threshold. It rests on the prior that occlusion lowers the confidence of visual evidence that the fixed window cannot compensate for. This criterion requires neither labels nor a learned gate. As the length of an occlusion is unknown in advance, the short-term memory maintains a rolling buffer of the most recent w max w_{\max} frames, so the leading context stays available. Once confidence recovers, we set w = clip ⁡ ( b − a , w min , w max ) w=\operatorname{clip}(b-a,\,w_{\min},\,w_{\max}) , giving the leading context 𝒞 − = [ a − w , a ) \mathcal{C}^{-}=[a-w,a) and trailing context 𝒞 + = [ b , b + w ) \mathcal{C}^{+}=[b,b+w) .
Consequently, we formulate the complete occluded event as 𝒮 = 𝒞 − ∪ 𝒪 h ∪ 𝒞 + \mathcal{S}=\mathcal{C}^{-}\cup\mathcal{O}^{h}\cup\mathcal{C}^{+} , as shown in Fig. 3 . For an out-of-sight interval 𝒰 h \mathcal{U}^{h} , we organize the leading and trailing context in essentially the same way as for an occluded event, thereby forming an out-of-sight event. After an event is resolved, the buffered evidence is released to keep the memory bounded.

blocks.en: Decoding an occluded event. Before detailing the readout for occluded events, we define how our MANO Decoder decodes camera-space hands p t p_{t} from a fixed window that is not assigned to any event. We first feed two input streams into the MANO Decoder, consisting of features from the frozen WiLoR ViT [ 25 ] and V-JEPA, both sampled from the hand crop region. Following [ 25 ] , we define a set of queries representing 6D rotations [ 45 ] , wrist depth, and hand shape. These queries then perform cross-attention with the two feature streams. Subsequently, they are augmented with a reliability embedding encoded from the confidence m t m_{t} and the keypoint in-image ratio. Temporal layers with RoPE-based frame-time embeddings [ 32 ] then enable cross-frame attention among queries over the window. Finally, these tokens are decoded into 16 per-joint rotations θ t \theta_{t} , wrist depth z t z_{t} , and per-window hand shape β \beta . After aligning the MANO keypoints to 𝐱 t \mathbf{x}_{t} via a closed-form solution to compute the lateral position, we obtain the camera-space hands.

In addition to this extended context, we design a Hand Feature Prediction (HFP) module that serves as a third input stream to the MANO Decoder during occlusions. blocks.en: Completing an out-of-sight event. An out-of-sight event differs from an occluded event in that its interval 𝒰 h \mathcal{U}^{h} lacks visual evidence of the hand. Meanwhile, a hand going out of sight may be driven by both head movement and hand motion, which are entangled in camera space. We therefore complete the memorized event in world space, where the two motions are naturally decoupled and hand-head synergy can compensate for the missing visual evidence in the out-of-sight interval. Specifically, in-image hands are first lifted into world space with scaled DPVO [ 35 ] camera poses (Sec. III-C ). Across 𝒰 h \mathcal{U}^{h} , we initialize coarse hand poses from the lifted hands in the available leading and trailing context held by the short-term memory via interpolation or extrapolation. A completion module then refines these coarse poses into the completed hands X ^ t h \hat{X}^{h}_{t} . To exploit head movement, the module injects it into the self-attention layers. In every attention head, half of the channels are modulated by per-frame camera rotations [ 20 ] and the other half by timestamps [ 32 ] , allowing attention to capture this synergy and improve out-of-sight completion accuracy.

blocks.en: In summary, the Short-Term Event Memory flexibly groups degraded intervals with their surrounding clear observations into self-contained events, retaining dense context only until each event is resolved. Across both occlusions and out-of-sight gaps, it thereby sustains continuous hand reconstruction beyond fixed-window limits.
blocks.zh: 简言之,短期事件记忆随着周围清晰的观察而灵活地将间隔退化成自成一体的事件,只保留了密集的上下文,直到每个事件得到解决. 无论是遮住还是视线外的缺口,它都维持了超过固定窗口限度的连续手力重建。

blocks.zh: 三-C 长期记忆

blocks.en: While the Short-Term Event Memory supplies event-level context beyond the fixed window, the invariants that hold across a whole video, such as hand shape and metric scale, still need a third range of context. Benefiting from the first two ranges, our predicted hand shape is largely stable, whereas the scale from Metric3D [ 7 ] alone lacks sufficient accuracy. The Long-Term Scale Memory therefore retains sparsely distributed anchors from both the reconstructed hands and monocular depth across the whole recording for accurate scale estimation, as shown in Fig. 2 (c).
blocks.zh: 虽然"短期事件记忆"提供固定窗口以外的事件级别上下文,但持有一整段视频的不变量,如手形和度量尺度,仍然需要第三范围上下文. 从前两个范围中受益,我们预测的手形基本稳定,而仅从Mitric3D[7]的尺度就不够准确。 因此,如图2(c)所示,长期规模记忆从重建的手和整个记录的单相深度中保留了分布稀少的锚,以便准确估计规模。

blocks.en: Hand Localizer. blocks.en: IV-B Camera-Space Hand Reconstruction
blocks.zh: IV-B相机-空间手重建

blocks.en: We first demonstrate that our combined short-term and long-term memory yields accurate camera-space hand reconstruction, the widely used evaluation setting in the field. The baselines and our MemHand are scored under the ACE-Ego-Hand [ 13 ] protocol. Notably, ACE-Ego-Hand evaluates out-of-sight hands only via a wrist-aligned error, neglecting their spatial placement. Alongside wrist-aligned MPJPE-p, we therefore introduce two out-of-sight metrics. Cov. is the ratio of completed missing frames, and OW-p is the mean Euclidean distance of non-aligned joints. The uncompleted out-of-sight hands are penalized in MPJPE-p and OW-p using a mean-shaped hand with identity rotation.
blocks.zh: 我们首先表明,我们短期和长期的综合记忆产生准确的相机-空间手重建,这是在实地广泛使用的评价设置。 根据ACE-Ego-Hand[13]协议,基准和我们的MemHand得分。 值得注意的是,ACE-Ego-Hand只通过手腕相通的误差来评价视外手,忽略了它们的空间定位. 除了手腕相通的MPJPE-p外,我们因此引入了两个视线外的度量. Cov.是已完工的缺失帧之比,而OW-p则是不相通关节的平均欧几利得相距. 在MPJPE-p和OW-p中,未完成的外观手会使用带有身份旋转的中形手进行处罚.

blocks.en: For ARCTIC, we share the same test set with ACE-Ego-Hand. Accordingly, we quote the results of HaMeR [ 24 ] , WiLoR [ 25 ] , and ACE-Ego-Hand from [ 13 ] directly, re-running them only to reproduce out-of-sight metrics. For Dyn-HaMR [ 41 ] and HaWoR [ 43 ] , we re-evaluate both methods via camera-space reprojection of their world-space outputs, thereby assessing their full workflows. For HOT3D and HOI4D, we re-run the baselines on our own test sets for a fair comparison. On HOT3D, ACE-Ego-Hand uses a smaller test set than our HaWoR split, so its training set necessarily includes our test sequences. However, since its exact data splits are not publicly available, we cannot rigorously exclude this effect, so the HOT3D results are provided for reference only. Out-of-sight metrics are omitted on HOI4D because it annotates visible hands only.
blocks.zh: 对于ACTIC,我们与ACE-Ego-Hand共享相同的测试集. 因此,我们引用HaMeR[24]、WiLOR[25]和ACE-Ego-Hand从[13]直接得出的结果,重新运行这些结果只是为了复制视线外的衡量标准。 对于Dyn-HAMR [41]和HAWOR [43],我们通过相机空间重新预测其世界空间产出来重新评估这两种方法,从而评估其全部工作流程. 对于HOT3D和HOI4D,我们重新在自己的测试集上运行基线,以便进行公平的比较. 在HOT3D上,ACE-Ego-Hand使用的测试集比我们的HAWOR分数要小,因此它的训练集必然包括我们的测试序列. 但是,由于它的确切数据分割不公开,我们不能严格排除这种效果,因此只提供HOT3D结果作为参考. 在HOI4D上省略了外观度量衡,因为它只标注了可见的手.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 1 , in like-for-like comparisons, MemHand outperforms the baselines in nearly all metrics, with only ACE-Ego-Hand edging ahead on jitter suppression. Even on HOT3D, where ACE-Ego-Hand serves as a favorable reference, its clear lead is confined to the out-of-sight metrics, where predictions lack visual anchoring and are therefore much more prone to memorizing seen trajectories. Notably, our advantage is more evident on zero-shot HOI4D, underscoring the cross-domain generalization capability. More qualitative comparisons are shown in Fig. 4 .
blocks.zh: 如表1所示,在相似的比较中,MemHand在几乎所有的度量中都超过了基线,只有ACE-Ego-Hand在颤抖抑制方面领先。 即使在HOT3D上,ACE-Ego-Hand作为一个有利的参考物,其明显的铅被限制在外视度量,预测物缺乏视觉锚地,因此更容易被记忆所见出轨迹. 值得注意的是,我们的优势在零发HOI4D上更为明显,突出了跨域通化能力. 图4显示了更多的质量比较。

blocks.en: IV-C World-Space Hand Reconstruction
blocks.zh: IV-C 世界空间手重建

blocks.en: We further validate that MemHand estimates accurate hand motion in world space. We follow the settings of InfiniHand [ 28 ] , which evaluates the full video allowing error accumulation without per-window resets using W-MPJPE, WA-MPJPE, and PA-MPJPE. Since InfiniHand scores only the in-image ground-truth hands matched by each method and omits out-of-sight ones, we report these metrics on the matched hands, out-of-sight hands, and all ground-truth hands. Moreover, we report Recall, the share of in-image ground-truth hands matched by a method’s output. As in InfiniHand, we evaluate WiLoR-SLAM [ 25 , 34 , 7 ] , HaWoR [ 43 ] , and Dyn-HaMR [ 41 ] locally as baselines. Besides, we directly quote InfiniHand’s published results on ARCTIC, as it is evaluated on the same test split. Since HOI4D lacks out-of-sight annotations, the out-of-sight columns are omitted. As shown in Table 2 , MemHand outperforms all baselines across all metrics. On matched hands, its PA-MPJPE stays relatively close to the baselines while W-MPJPE improves substantially, showing that our gain lies mainly in world-space hand placement. Notably, our clear margin persists on zero-shot HOI4D, demonstrating strong generalization in world-space hand motion estimation. Qualitative comparisons over whole test sequences are shown in Fig. 5 , where all the trajectories are anchored at the first frame without further alignment.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步证实,MemHand估计世界空间的手动准确。 我们遵循InfiniHand [28] 的设置,该设定评价了完整视频,允许使用W-MPJPE,WA-MPJPE和PA-MPJPE在每窗重播的情况下进行错误累积. 由于InfiniHand只评出与每种方法相匹配的内相地真手,并省去外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相外相 此外,我们报告回顾,在某种方法输出的同时,图像中的地面真人手的份额。 如同InfiniHand,我们评价WiLOR-SLAM [25,34,7],HAWOR [43],以及Dyn-HAMR [41]作为当地的基线. 此外,我们直接引用InfiniHand在ACTIC上发表的结果,因为它在同一测试分中被评价. 由于HOI4D缺乏外观说明,外观列被省略. 如表2所示,MemHand的绩效超过了所有指标的所有基线。 在匹配的手上,它的PA-MPJPE保持相对接近基线,而W-MPJPE则大幅改进,表明我们的收益主要在于世界空间手放. 值得注意的是,我们在零发HOI4D上保持了明显的差值,显示出世界-空间手动运动估计的强烈概括. 图5显示了整个测试序列的定性比较,其中所有轨迹都锚定在第一帧上而无需再对齐.

blocks.en: Moreover, we evaluate MemHand on the benchmark of StableHand [ 42 ] , a SOTA world-space hand reconstruction method. Since the official release provides an enhanced version that outperforms the results reported in its paper, we use this version for our comparison. We follow its evaluation protocol, except on HOT3D where we retain only the test clips unseen by both methods for a fair comparison. As shown in Table 3 , MemHand outperforms StableHand on most metrics. The gain is most pronounced in W-MPJPE, which measures world-space hand placement accuracy over the entire clip. Specifically, MemHand reduces W-MPJPE by 57% on ARCTIC and 70% on HOT3D. Notably, StableHand uses privileged ground-truth hand shape in its released evaluation, whereas MemHand relies on its own predicted shape, further underscoring the effectiveness of our method.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们以StableHand[42]为基准评价MemHand,这是一种SOTA世界-空间手重建方法. 由于官方发布提供了超过其论文所报道结果的强化版本,我们使用这个版本进行比较. 我们遵循其评估程序,但HOT3D除外,我们只保留两种方法所看不到的试验片段,以便进行公平比较。 如表3所示,MemHand在大多数衡量标准上的表现都超过StableHand。 增益在W-MPJPE中最为明显,它测量了整个剪辑上的世界-空间手放精度. 具体来说,MemHand在ARCTIC上将W-MPJPE减少57%,在HOT3D上减少70%. 值得注意的是, " 稳定汉德 " 在其发布的评价中采用了特殊地面真实的手形,而MemHand则依靠其自身的预测形状,进一步强调了我们的方法的有效性。

blocks.en: IV-D Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: IV-D 读取研究

blocks.en: Memory mechanisms. We first ablate the benefits of our memory mechanism, with results shown in Table 4 . Following ACE-Ego-Hand, we adopt a reduced training recipe where all ablation variants are only trained on ARCTIC for half the epochs of the main pipeline. We first reconstruct the entire pipeline based on single-frame DINOv3 ViT-H+ [ 31 ] , denoted as (a). (b) allows DINOv3 feature fusion within a fixed window and outperforms (a). (c) replaces DINOv3 with V-JEPA over the same fixed window, achieving further gains over (b), which justifies our backbone choice. (d) incorporates short-term occluded event memory and yields additional improvements over (c), demonstrating the effectiveness of HFP features and the extended temporal context. (e) further adds short-term memory for out-of-sight events, substantially improving predictions for out-of-sight hands. The gains of (d) and (e) together validate the necessity of our short-term memory. Finally, (f) adds long-term scale memory, which further improves world-space motion accuracy compared to the scale estimated by Metric3D in (e).
blocks.zh: 记忆机制. 我们首先放弃记忆机制的好处,结果见表4。 继ACE-Ego-Hand之后,我们采用了一种减量的训练食谱,即所有减量变体只接受ACTIC主要管线一半时期的培训. 我们首先根据单帧的DINov3 VIT-H+[31]重建整个管道,表示为(a)。 (b) 允许在固定窗口内进行DINOv3特性聚变并超越(a)。 (c) 在同一固定窗口上用V-JEPA取代DINOv3, 取得比(b)的进一步收益,这使我们有理由选择骨干。 (d) 纳入短期闭塞事件记忆,并产生与(c)相比的更多改进,表明HFP特性的有效性和较长的时间背景。 (e) 进一步增加外视事件短期记忆,大大改进外视手的预测。 (d)和(e)的成果共同证明了我们短期记忆的必要性。 最后, (f) 增加了长期尺度内存,这与(e)中Mettric3D估计的尺度相比,进一步提高了世界-空间运动的准确性.

blocks.en: To further validate our long-term memory, we include reference row (g) with the ground-truth scale aligned from the camera trajectory. As scale error accumulates with camera translation, the subtle tabletop head motion of ARCTIC leaves only a 3.0 mm margin in W even with the ground-truth scale, of which our memory already captures ∼ 70 % {\sim}70\% . On HOT3D and zero-shot HOI4D, where camera translation is larger, the gain over Metric3D-based scale is much clearer, reducing W from 40.1 to 35.5 mm and from 99.2 to 88.3 mm, against 32.8 and 76.2 mm with the ground-truth scale. Moreover, as more observations accumulate over time, the median scale error of our memory on HOT3D sequences longer than 60 s steadily drops from 9.2% at 5 s to 3.4% at 60 s and 2.9% over the full recording, demonstrating its progressive scale refinement.

blocks.en: Input features for MANO Decoder. We further ablate the input features of the MANO Decoder, namely V-JEPA, WiLoR ViT, and HFP. blocks.en: Out-of-sight completion. We ablate the out-of-sight completion strategy. As shown in Table 6 , simple interpolation between boundary hand poses yields suboptimal results. Using hand poses only as temporal context for out-of-sight event completion already yields a noticeable performance gain. When further introducing head motion information, the accuracy improves substantially. This verifies our claim that out-of-sight completion can be performed in world space with head-hand coordination.

blocks.en: IV-E Human Preference Study
blocks.zh: IV-E 人类优先研究

blocks.en: Following [ 39 ] , we conduct a human preference study on in-the-wild data to verify which hand reconstruction results align better with human perception. Specifically, we collect 400 egocentric videos using an iPhone and a RealSense D435i. We reconstruct hands on these videos with WiLoR, HaWoR, ACE-Ego-Hand, and MemHand, and render the results onto the original frames for visualization. A total of 53 in-house volunteers not involved in this project are shown anonymized reconstructions from the four methods in a randomly shuffled layout for each video, and asked to select the most visually plausible result. As shown in Fig. 6 , MemHand is preferred in 66.2% of the comparisons. This could be attributed to MemHand exhibiting fewer false detections, identity flips, and temporal discontinuities under occlusion, yielding higher perceptual quality.
blocks.zh: 继[39]之后,我们开展了人类偏好研究,以了解哪些手重建成果更符合人类的认知。 具体来说,我们用iPhone和RealSense D435i收集了400个以自我为中心的视频. 我们用WiLOR、HaWOR、ACE-Ego-Hand和MemHand来重建这些视频的手, 共有53名未参与该项目的内部志愿者在每部视频的随机打乱布局中从四种方法中显示匿名重建,并要求选择最明显可信的结果。 如图6所示,在66.2%的比较中首选MemHand. 这可能是因为MemHand显示的假检测次数较少,身份翻转,以及被隔离下的时间不连续,从而产生更高的感知质量.

blocks.en: IV-F Runtime Analysis
blocks.zh: IV-F 运行时间分析

blocks.en: We further evaluate the efficiency of MemHand on an A100 GPU over the ARCTIC test sequences. Camera-space hand reconstruction alone runs at 26.1 FPS, with the frozen V-JEPA encoder accounting for 57% of the cost. For world-space reconstruction, it runs concurrently with camera tracking and depth estimation on separate CUDA streams of the same GPU, yielding an end-to-end throughput of 13.7 FPS. As shown in Table 7 , MemHand runs 1.6 × 1.6\times as fast as WiLoR-SLAM, 3.9 × 3.9\times as fast as HaWoR, and 12.5 × 12.5\times as fast as the optimization-based Dyn-HaMR, while being the most accurate. However, since the hands in a frame are decoded once the fixed window or event covering it closes, MemHand introduces a decoding lag, with 50% of the reconstructed hands on both ARCTIC and HOT3D decoded within 101 frames and 95% within 193 and 145 frames, respectively.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步评估A100GPU上的MemHand在ARCTIC测试序列上的效率. 光是相机空间手部重建就以26.1 FPS运行,被冻结的V-JEPA编码器占成本的57%. 就世界空间重建而言,它与相机跟踪和深度估计同时运行于同一GPU的单独的CUDA流上,产生从端到端的吞吐量为13.7 FPS. 如表7所示,MemHand的运行速度为:快于WiLOR-SLAM;快于HaWOR;快于12.5×12.5;快于基于优化的Dyn-HAMR;而快于最精确. 然而,由于一个帧中的双手在固定窗口或覆盖它的事件关闭后即被解码,MemHand引入了解码滞后,重建后双手的50%分别被ARCTIC和HOT3D解码在101帧内,95%被解码在193和145帧内.

blocks.en: V Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we propose a novel world-space hand motion estimation framework MemHand. It provides rich temporal context for occluded and out-of-sight segments via a devised short-term memory, and maintains accurate scale estimation through long-term memory. Experimental results validate that MemHand outperforms existing baselines on various metrics. Although the entire MemHand system achieves approximately 14 FPS on a single A100, it is still not real-time, considering the latency introduced by whole-event decoding. In the future, we plan to explore more efficient methods of temporal context utilization.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提出一个全新的世界-空间手动估计框架"MemHand". 它通过设计出来的短期内存,为闭塞和外视段提供了丰富的时间背景,并通过长期内存维持精确的尺度估计. 实验结果证实,MemHand在各种衡量标准上的表现超过了现有基线。 尽管整个MemHand系统在单A100上实现了约14个FPS,但考虑到由全事解码引入的耐久性,它仍然不实时. 今后,我们计划探索更有效的时间背景利用方法。
